A '''copper sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Copper equipment|copper]] tier, crafted from two [[copper ingot]]s and a stick. It deals {{Hp|5}} damage, one more than the [[wooden sword]] and one less than the [[iron sword]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
The copper sword deals {{Hp|5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 350 durability, almost twice the vanilla copper sword's 190.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it can be melted down into a single copper ingot. It is also the base item for the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] and [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] upgrades at a [[smithing table]].
